"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"As a result of the previous administration's decision, Iran has gone from being more than a year away from being able to produce enough weapons grade material for a bomb to a matter of weeks, should it choose to do so.",

"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Biden remains committed to a diplomatic solution with Iran.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Biden is resolute that Iran will never be allowed to develop nuclear weapons.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Biden and Vice President Harris believe a strong, secure, and democratic Israel is vital to the interests of the United States.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"President Biden and Vice President Harris's commitment to Israel's security, its qualitative military edge, its right to defend itself, and the 2016 Memorandum of Understanding is ironclad.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"President Biden and Vice President Harris recognize the worth of every innocent life, whether Israeli or Palestinian.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
